summary: @ornikar/storybook-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: Version 12.1.7 of @ornikar/storybook-config ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs` declared in package.json) that probes for a local `bun` binary and, if absent, downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled `math_init.js` sibling file. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-compiled module (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) containing a shuffled numeric string array and a rotating array-shift decoder; no source form is shipped. `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated with hex-named identifiers and per-function string tables. The payload runs under the Bun runtime specifically, so Node-based inspection tooling does not see the executed code. The package's declared purpose is Storybook configuration and index.js exports only Storybook config; the Bun runtime download and the 727 KB opaque compiled artifact have no relation to that purpose. Behavior is consistent with a compromised-maintainer or scope-hijack release delivering an obfuscated payload under a legitimate-looking package name; installing this version executes attacker-supplied compiled code with the installing user's permissions on developer workstations and CI runners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
